name: Поліпшення позиції фігури (2)
description:
After all your pieces have been developed, you move on to optimization. In the middle game you can constantly ask yourself: which piece can I improve? Compare the activity of all your pieces and look for a piece that could receive a new task.

What do you have to do?

Improve a piece by moving it to a more active square.

examples.text: З точним 1.Qb3! білі можуть поцілити в чорного пішака на b7.
Білі хоче залишити фігури на дошці тут. Це можна зробити за допомогою енергійного 1.Nc5!. Білі ускладнюють розвиток чорних, і білі можуть продовжити Re1 на наступному ході.

texts: ферзь тут чудова. Білі не можуть добре захистити слабкого пішака електронних шахів.
Розвивайте свої фігури агресивно.
Це посилює тиск на пішака d6 і зв’язує чорного коня.
Створіть смертоносну зв’язку.
The queen was passive, but that's no longer the case. Black must watch out for the white queen landing on f6.
Розвивайте свої фігури агресивно.
The white knight jumps forward to pressure the black king. A combination with Nxh6+ is now threatened.
Розвивайте свої фігури агресивно.
Knights prefer to be away from the edge. The knight puts pressure on the white center.
Move your pieces to the center.
The bishop is very active here. Moreover, the white e-pawn is now indirectly attacked.
Improve pieces that aren't doing much.
This improves the rook's position. The pin is no longer in effect. Suddenly, the white c- and e-pawns are under pressure.
Make sure your knight is no longer pinned.
The knight beautifully in the center. Pawn f7 is under pressure and also Black's bishop is now vulnerable.
кінь у центрі схожий на короля на своєму троні.
The knight is ideally placed in the center. The black f-pawn is under heavy pressure.
Attack the weak point in Black's position.
The knight controls key white squares on the queenside and clears the way for the bishop on c8.
«Перемістіть свої фігури на оптимальні поля шахівниці».
Knights don't belong on the rim. From c4, the knight can reach e5 and e3.
"Place your pieces on optimal squares."
f7 is the weak point in Black's position. White increases the pressure slowly.
Attack the weak spot in black's position.
puzzles.text: Note that the break move e5-e6 also becomes a threat, as it creates a double attack on the black bishop.

texts: Black wants to keep the bishop. Square c5 is ideal, as the bishop pressures the white f-pawn.
Avoid a bad trade and activate your pieces.
The bishop is very active here.
Develop your pieces to active squares and create a deadly threat.
puzzles.text: Black increases control over f3 and also limits the white queen's mobility. Black now threatens to win the white queen with ...Bf6, and white can't really do anything about it.

texts: The black kingside is weak and white increases the pressure.
"Find black's weak spot."
